notes.title: The Frightfest Update - Patch Alpha 1.2.00 [Content Update]
notes.notes:
[h1]Frightening Festivities[/h1]

[list]
[*] Check out the temporary Frightfest decorations that are put up all over the city!
[*] Listen to all the spooky stories the locals have to tell!
[*] Enjoy a Frightfest-themed drink at the bar!
[*] Hunt for Cronchies and sell them to [i]"The Croncher"[/i]!
[/list]

notes.title: The Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing the first complete version of the Prologue of Textbound Tales!
You can download it right now FOR FREE by trying the Textbound Tales Playtest!

This update also marks the start of the development of the open world areas.

[h3]Included in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slight overhaul of various scenarios.
[*] Added more NPCs and characters for various scenarios.
[*] Rewrote lore-breaking scenarios.
[/list]
[h3]Future plans:[/h3]
We wanted to give you an idea of what would still be coming to the playtest in the future
[olist]
[*] Small special content update.
[*] 1st open world area.
[*] expanded open world with crafting and gathering scenarios.
[*] much more to come!
[/olist]

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/8Gj9SqpXtz]Discord[/url] if you want to stay in touch with the developers!
